reader_notes: Elegant essayistic Swedish; 'Det var som om handen såg en lösning som pennan aldrig fick syn på' is the kind of line a real essayist writes.

The author's self-interruption ('Här vill jag genast bromsa mig själv') explicitly rejects the instrumental defence of slöjd, which makes Q2 option A cleanly wrong rather than merely unsupported - well constructed.
Boströms hedge ('överföringen till matematiken var svag och osäker, och gällde långtifrån alla') is what kills Q1 option C; the hedge is doing real work rather than being decoration.
Q1 option B inverts the direction of the observation (bench-skill leading to instruction-following rather than the reverse) - a good, non-obvious distractor.
Short unit, two items, both unambiguous.
